Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Learned A.P.P. opposes the prayer for bail.

The petitioners are accused for allegedly committing an offence punishable under Sections 429, 406,
188, 120-B/34 IPC and u/s 11(a) (d) (e)
(i) (k) of Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and Rule 3 of Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Slaughter House) Rules, 2001 and Section 55 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
Counsel for the petitioners submits that he is not relying on Annexure-3/2.

entities.text: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Slaughter House) Rules, 2001
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Due to inadvertence, the same has been annexed and submission to that effect that he is also not relying on sub-para-4 of Para 13 of the statement of this petitioner.
Counsel for the petitioners submits that some camels were confiscated and they were entrusted to this petitioner and others.
These petitioners and others were directed to produce the said animals but they could not produce the same.
It is presumed that petitioners have slaughtered the animals.
He submits that petitioners have falsely been implicated in this case.
Petitioners are in custody since 26.5.2018.
Taking into consideration the period of custody and nature of allegation, I am inclined to allow this application.

Accordingly, the petitioners above named are directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like Nazir Mian @ Najir Mian vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... Opp
